findings.title: Update check loop sleeps a fixed 86400 s after a launch check that UpdateChecker skips when the last check is < 24 h old, so the real gap reaches ~48 h
findings.evidence: startUpdateCheckLoop calls updates.checkIfNeeded() at launch then sleeps a fixed 86_400 s; checkIfNeeded skips when ai_taskbar_last_update_check_at is < 24 h old. Check at 23:34, relaunch at 10:00 -> skipped -> next attempt 10:00 next day (34.5 h). Reported by the user (product owner).
findings.fix: A check is due when there is no previous check, the last check was on an earlier local calendar day, or >= 24 h elapsed. Pure injectable isCheckDue(lastCheck:now:calendar:) and delayUntilNextCheck(lastCheck:now:calendar:) (0 if due, else min(next local midnight, lastCheck+24h) - now, 60 s floor, never > 24 h); loop sleeps the computed delay and recomputes after every iteration.
findings.impact: Update notices arrive up to ~2 days late; a relaunch on a new day does not check
